interface.description: Wireless interface name (e.g., wlan0); monitor mode is auto-enabled.

output_file.description: Output file path; '-' for stdout, '+' for stdout with radiotap header.

frames.description: Bitmask of frame types to capture: 1 (MGT), 2 (EAP/EAPOL) = default 3.

frequency.description: Channel (≤1000) or frequency in MHz (>1000); 0 = auto.

dwell_time.description: Time (seconds) to stay on frequency before hopping.

eapoleap_timeout.description: EAP EAPOL timeout in microseconds over entire sequence.

stop_client_m2_attacks.description: Stop client M2 attacks after receiving N M2 frames (0 = unlimited).

stop_ap_attacks.description: Stop AP attacks after receiving N BEACONs.

resume_ap_attacks.description: Resume AP attacks after N BEACONs (e.g., ~10 days at 1 BEACON/s).

weak_candidate.description: Pre-shared key (8–63 chars) for weak PSK alerting (saved to pcapng).

active_beacon.description: Transmit beacon from collected ESSIDs every 10s.

flood_beacon.description: Transmit beacon on every received beacon (ap-less attack).

essidlist.description: Path to file with ESSIDs to beacon (max 256 entries).

beacon_params.description: Hex string of TLV IEs (max 50); tags 0/3 ignored/overwritten.

filterlist_ap.description: Path to AP filter list or single MAC.

filterlist_client.description: Path to client filter list or single MAC.

filterlist_ap_vendor.description: Path to AP OUI (3-byte) filter list.

filterlist_client_vendor.description: Path to client OUI (3-byte) filter list.

do_targetscan.description: Target AP MAC to scan (others hidden).

do_rcascan.description: Perform radio channel scan on startup.

use_gpsd.description: Use GPSD daemon for GPS data.

gpio_button.description: Raspberry Pi GPIO pin for button (2–27); 0 = disabled.

gpio_statusled.description: Raspberry Pi GPIO pin for status LED (2–27); 0 = disabled.

gpio_statusled_interval.description: GPIO LED flash interval in seconds.

status_ip.description: IP for status server/client (multicast or unicast).

force_interface.description: Bypass ioctl checks (dangerous on virtual interfaces).

eapreq.description: EAP request sequence (max 20) as hex string with mode prefix.

eapreq_follownak.description: Follow requested Auth Type in Legacy NAK.
